standard.summary: pil 最兼容；pil_lru 会按文件 mtime/大小缓存已解码 RGB
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.pil_lru: PIL 加缓存，重复读快，吃内存。

standard_en.summary: pil is the most compatible; pil_lru caches decoded RGB keyed on file mtime and size
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.pil_lru: PIL with a cache: fast on repeat reads, hungry for memory.

advanced.principle: pil 最兼容；pil_lru 会按文件 mtime/大小缓存已解码 RGB/Alpha；torchvision_cpu 使用 torchvision 在 CPU 解码后回到现有 PIL augment 链路，不提前占用训练显存。

advanced_en.principle: pil is the most compatible; pil_lru caches decoded RGB/Alpha keyed by file mtime/size; torchvision_cpu decodes on CPU via torchvision and returns to the existing PIL augment chain, without occupying training VRAM early.
